paper: Reconfigurable Macropixel for Concurrent Static-Dynamic Visual Perception (Fig. 5, scene reconstruction)
protocol: 30 REDS-derived evaluation scenes x 95 frames (2,850 samples); GT = first frame of the exposure window; conventional baseline = bicubic upsampling of the same blurred input

matched_difficulty_subset.definition: scenes with conventional PSNR <= 21.6 dB (degradation at least as severe as the original test conditions)

dynamic_static_pixels.definition: dynamic = pixels with >= 2 events in the exposure window, 5x5 dilated, nearest-resized to HR (input-side only)

region_gains.definition: 128x128 tiles; blurred region = worst 25% of tiles by baseline error

source: full split measured 2026-09-15..17 with checkpoint rmp_real_ft4/latest_G.pth; bundled-scene rows re-verified with the released package (src/evaluate.py) on 2026-10-09

bundled_scenes.note: three of the 30 evaluation scenes ship with this package (028: highest mean gain; 012: highest single-tile gain, the scene of Fig. 5c,d; 013: low-motion control); the values below are the manuscript's reference rows for these scenes, results/per_scene_expected.csv is the full 30-scene table
